action.meaning: joint pos RESIDUAL over the reference motion's joint_pos at the current control step: target = ref_joint_pos(t) + scale * a (metadata action_semantics=residual_joint_position)
action.offset: reference joint pos (NOT default pose); action_offset metadata = 0.0

terms.name: command.ref_joint_pos
terms.frame: joint space, ABSOLUTE reference joint angles (not minus default)

terms.name: command.ref_anchor_height
terms.frame: world z of reference pelvis (plane terrain, env origin z=0)

terms.name: command.ref_anchor_roll
terms.frame: world (ZYX euler roll of ref pelvis quat, atan2 form)

terms.name: base_ang_vel
terms.frame: body (gyro 'imu_ang_vel' at site imu_in_pelvis, unrotated vs pelvis; runner uses mj_objectVelocity(pelvis, local=1)[0:3])

terms.name: actions
terms.frame: raw previous policy output (before scale, unclipped)

terms.name: history
terms.frame: 10 x 157 block, each block = [command(64), base_ang_vel(3), projected_gravity(3), joint_pos_rel(29), joint_vel(29), last_action(29)] (no noise inside history in training: the term itself has no noise cfg, it calls the raw mdp funcs)

obs.term_order_note: concatenation order = command(64) | base_ang_vel(3) | projected_gravity(3) | joint_pos(29) | joint_vel(29) | actions(29) | history(1570); slices given in ONNX metadata observation_terms_layout. base_lin_vel is NOT in the actor obs (critic-only).
obs.history_layout: oldest-first (time-major [t-H..t-1] per training; see open_questions on off-by-one vs their MuJoCo runner). On reset the buffer is filled with H copies of the current block.
obs.normalization: obs normalizer is baked into the ONNX graph (initializer names start with obs_normalizer.*); feed raw obs

reference.type: root+joints (joint pos+vel of all 29 joints + pelvis planar lin vel (body), yaw rate (body), height, roll, pitch)
reference.includes_root: height (world z), roll/pitch (world), lin vel xy + ang vel z in reference pelvis frame; no global x/y or yaw (yaw-invariant)
reference.coordinate frame: world z-up; quats wxyz; reference sampled by time with linear interp (joints, pos, vel) and slerp (quat) between motion frames
reference.motion_file_format: NPZ minimal: fps, root_pos[T,3], root_quat_w[T,4] wxyz, joint_pos[T,29] in joint_order (body kinematics recomputed by FK in mjlab G1, joint_vel by np.gradient). Extended: fps, joint_pos, joint_vel, body_pos_w, body_quat_w, body_lin_vel_w, body_ang_vel_w, body_names. Also TWIST2 PKL (root_pos, root_rot xyzw, dof_pos). Root/anchor body = pelvis.

how_they_run_it: run_yahmp_onnx_mujoco.py builds the mjlab task scene (Mjlab-YAHMP-Unitree-G1) as a MuJoCo model (physics dt 0.005, control dt 0.02 checked against ONNX metadata), initialises the free joint and joints from the first reference frame (root pos/quat/lin/ang vel and joint pos/vel; --init-default-joints uses the default pose instead), then each control step: sample the reference at playback time t (lerp/slerp), compute terms: command (64) from the reference, pelvis ang vel from mj_objectVelocity local frame, projected gravity from pelvis xquat, joint_pos-default, joint_vel, previous raw action; concatenate command|proprio|history -> obs[1727]; run ONNX; ctrl = ref_joint_pos(t)[targets] + action*action_scale written to MuJoCo position actuators (kp/kd as in metadata); mj_step x4; t += 0.02; previous_action = raw action; recompute terms at the new t and push the 157-d current block into the 10-step history (newest last). Motion time wraps modulo clip length.
code_refs: src/yahmp/src/yahmp/config/g1/env_cfgs.py:65-77 (DelayedActuator 0-4 physics-step lag on position target), 86-93, 120-122 (G1_ACTION_SCALE), 134-138 (anchor/root = pelvis)
src/mjlab_ref/g1_constants.py (mjlab v1.2.0, 5af32e3):100-187 (actuators, kp=armature*(2pi*10)^2, kd=2*2*armature*2pi*10), 207-219 (KNEES_BENT default pose), 287-295 (action scale = 0.25*effort/kp)
open_questions: History timing off-by-one: training YahmpObservationHistory returns [t-10..t-1] (excluding current) then appends current (observations.py:374-378), but run_yahmp_onnx_mujoco.py appends the post-step block so its history at step t is [t-9..t] (lines 867-878 then 844). Which one to reproduce? Training semantics is the safer default; their sim2sim works with the other.
Training used DelayedActuatorCfg with 0-4 physics-step (0-20 ms) position-target lag (env_cfgs.py:65-77); the MuJoCo runner applies no delay.
Gyro: training reads the MuJoCo gyro sensor at imu_in_pelvis; runner uses pelvis body local angular velocity. Equal for a rigid body with unrotated site, so harmless.
Effort limits are from mjlab g1_constants (forcerange on position actuators); verified consistent with the exported action_scale = 0.25*effort/kp for all 29 joints.
The interface fields (joint order, default pose, kp/kd, obs layout) were read from ONNX metadata_props strings with our own protobuf walker; graph tensors were not inspected.

twist2_1017_25k.onnx (TWIST2 baseline): obs 1432 = 127*(1 current + 10 history) + 35 (future mimic block filled with current mimic); mimic(35)=[root lin vel xy (body), root z, roll, pitch, yaw rate (body), 29 joint pos]; proprio(92)=[ang_vel*0.25, roll, pitch, q-default, qdot*0.05 (ankle vels zeroed optionally), last action]; target = TWIST2 default + 0.5*clip(a,-10,10). See run_twist2_onnx_mujoco.py:130-138, 459-548, 767-819. Its own default pose / gains are profiles at lines 62-129, 154-384. Not specced in full here.

runtime.action_offset='ref_joint_pos' is outside the documented runtime format ('default' or [29]): YAHMP actions are residuals over the CURRENT reference joint pos (mdp/actions.py:38-46, run_yahmp_onnx_mujoco.py:713-718). The runner needs a per-tick offset = ref_joint_pos(t).
runtime.velocity_limit = mjlab ElectricActuator datasheet values (g1_constants.py:100-119); they were NOT enforced in training (BuiltinPositionActuatorCfg built without them).

ONNX IO names 'obs'/'actions' come from rl/policy.py:719-725 (_OnnxYahmpActorModel.input_names/output_names). (Earlier, before the no-open rule, the ONNX metadata_props were read with our own protobuf walker; that is where joint order/default pose/kp/kd in this spec were cross-checked from, and they match mjlab g1_constants.py.)
runtime history steps follow training ([-10..-1]); their MuJoCo runner effectively uses [-9..0] (see first open question).

trained_in.value: mjlab 1.2.0 (MuJoCo Warp, GPU MuJoCo); physics dt 0.005, decimation 4, solver iterations 10 / ls_iterations 20. Not Isaac/PhysX: PhysX attachment is a sim-to-sim transfer.

actuator_model.value: implicit PD: mjlab BuiltinPositionActuatorCfg = MuJoCo position actuator (kp, kd via biasprm) with forcerange = effort_limit and joint armature. Wrapped in DelayedActuatorCfg: position target delayed by a random 0-4 physics steps (0-20 ms), delay_hold_prob 1.0, resampled per episode/term. No obs delay. Actions are residuals over the reference joint pos: target = ref_q + scale*a (so in Isaac use a custom action term, or JointPositionActionCfg with per-step offset = ref_q; a static offset=default pose is WRONG).

velocity_limit.value: none enforced in sim: BuiltinPositionActuatorCfg is built without velocity_limit. Motor datasheet values exist in ElectricActuator but are unused for the actuator: 5020 37 rad/s, 7520_14 32, 7520_22 20, 4010 22. Suggest velocity_limit_sim large (or these datasheet values).

self_collision.value: OFF in training: FULL_COLLISION_WITHOUT_SELF (contype=0, conaffinity=1 on all *_collision geoms, so robot geoms only collide with terrain). Self-collision reward/sensor commented out.

default_root_height.value: 0.76 m pelvis (KNEES_BENT_KEYFRAME pos z). Episodes actually start from the reference motion's first frame (+/- pose_range noise), not this keyframe.

terrain_friction.value: flat plane only. Foot geoms (left|right)_foot[1-7]_collision condim 3, priority 1, nominal friction 0.6; DR at startup sets foot friction absolute U(0.3,1.2) shared per env. Other robot geoms condim 1. Also DR: torso COM offset (+/-2.5 cm x, +/-5 cm y/z), velocity pushes every 1-3 s, end-effector force pushes up to 20 N on wrist_yaw links.

hands.value: none actuated; G1 29-DoF mjlab model with rubber-hand meshes rigidly part of left/right_wrist_yaw_link, each with one capsule collision geom (hand_collision).

teleop_reference.value: none in the repo for the released model. Reference must be a G1 joint-space motion (joint pos/vel + pelvis height, roll, pitch, body-frame lin vel xy, yaw rate), e.g. from an external retargeter (GMR or similar). TWIST2 PKL compatibility exists for offline clips only. A HandBase command variant (hand poses + pelvis) exists in code but is not the shipped ONNX.

realtime_lookahead.value: 0 future frames for g1_yahmp.onnx (motion_command_step_offsets empty, single current step), so a live stream needs no faked future. Joint/pelvis velocities must be supplied (finite-difference the stream). The Future variant (FutureJointRefAnchorRpMotionCommand) would need future frames but is not shipped.

deploy_rate.value: 50 Hz policy (control_dt 0.02), sim 200 Hz. No real-robot deploy code in repo (MuJoCo sim2sim only).

isaac.isaac_attach_summary: ImplicitActuatorCfg per joint: stiffness=kp, damping=kd, armature=armature, effort_limit_sim=effort_limit (all in spec, policy joint order = Unitree/Isaac-URDF depth-first order, NOT Isaac Lab breadth-first). sim.dt 0.005, decimation 4, self-collision off, default pose = KNEES_BENT, root 0.76 m. Action: residual over reference joint pos with per-joint scale = action.scale.

ref_joint_pos.note: runner built-in; ABSOLUTE reference joint angles in policy order (rad)

ref_joint_vel.note: runner built-in; reference joint velocities (rad/s), from NPZ or np.gradient of joint_pos at clip fps

ref_anchor_lin_vel_xy_b.frame: reference pelvis body frame: quat_apply_inverse(ref_pelvis_quat_w, ref_pelvis_lin_vel_w)[:2]

ref_anchor_yaw_rate_b.frame: reference pelvis body frame: quat_apply_inverse(ref_pelvis_quat_w, ref_pelvis_ang_vel_w)[2]

ref_root_height.note: runner built-in; reference pelvis world z (m), flat ground at z=0

ref_anchor_roll.frame: world; ZYX-euler roll of ref pelvis quat: atan2(2(wx+yz), 1-2(x^2+y^2))

base_ang_vel.note: runner built-in; pelvis gyro (site imu_in_pelvis, unrotated), body frame, rad/s, no scale

last_action.note: raw policy output of previous tick, unscaled, unclipped; zeros at reset

history_block.note: 3rd block = 10 past ticks of the 157-d current block, oldest first, time-major, excluding current tick (training semantics, observations.py:323-378). On reset all 10 slots = copies of the current block. Ref terms in the history are the reference values that were current at those past ticks.

reference.source: other:G1 joint-space motion clip (NPZ fps/root_pos/root_quat_w wxyz/joint_pos); no retargeter shipped

runtime.obs_normalization_ref: src/yahmp/src/yahmp/rl/policy.py:690,704 (obs_normalizer copied into the ONNX wrapper)
runtime.ref_zero_joints_why: g1_yahmp.onnx's obs normalizer has std at the 0.01 floor and mean 0 for the 6 wrist ref joint_pos and joint_vel dims (current 19-21,26-28,48-50,55-57, and each of the 10 history frames: 132 dims): the training references held the wrists at 0, so a non-zero GMR wrist reference is ~100 sigma out of distribution. Found by Humanoid Bench's static read of the normalizer, checked here. Hand orientation is not tracked.

measured.how: onnx.load graph + onnxruntime CPU, 1 thread, batch 1, random inputs, 200 runs on the dev laptop (2026-11-03). TorchScript archives are not loaded; params estimated from tensor blobs.
